sources.title: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍 / Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍
sources.title_en: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_original: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.summary: Anthropic 发布内部研究称，技术部门初级岗位占比从 2025 年初的 21% 降至 14%，新招初级占比从 27% 降至 9%，空缺初级职位降至 6%，非技术部门基本稳定。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic内部研究显示，新员工中初级职位占比从27%降至9%，到2026年8月其AI agents工作时长已达人类的六倍，工程师代码提交量增至5.1倍，研究者Nolan Lovett警告这将导致资深人才断档。

en.summary: Anthropic published internal research showing that the share of junior roles in its technical organization fell from 21% in early 2025 to 14%, the share of new junior hires dropped from 27% to 9%, and open junior positions fell to 6%, while non-technical departments remained largely stable.
en.reason: Anthropic’s research found technical junior roles dropping from 21% to 14% and new-hire junior share from 27% to 9%, while AI agents worked six times human hours by August 2026, and Nolan Lovett warned of a senior-talent pipeline gap.

stories.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say

sources.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_zh: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责
sources.title_en: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_original: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.summary: 慕尼黑地区法院 I 五月底裁定 Google 的 AI 搜索摘要属于公司自己的陈述而非中立转述，Google 须为错误内容担责；Google 公开宣布上诉后实际以和解结案，未获上级法院裁决。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Aachen Regional Court在2026年9月24日裁决中沿用Munich法院逻辑，认定Google的AI把本属他人的性侵指控错安到一位医生身上，AI答案即公司自身内容。

en.summary: Munich Regional Court I ruled in late May that Google's AI search summaries count as the company's own statements rather than neutral retransmission, making Google liable for erroneous content. After publicly announcing an appeal, Google in fact settled the case, so no higher court ever ruled on it.
en.reason: Aachen Regional Court’s 24 September 2026 ruling, following Munich Regional Court’s late-May logic, held Google liable because its AI overview wrongly attributed another person’s sexual-assault allegation to a doctor, treating AI answers as Google’s own content.

AI 的本质不是软件工程，而是生物演化。

我们正在踏入物理、数学与科技全面大爆发的年代。但大多数人对 AI 的理解，依然停留在极度浅层的阶段。

AI 的本质，其实就是“仿生学”。

en.title: Stanford has released another great course for free.
en.summary:
Stanford has released another great course for free.

CME 295 is all about Transformers and large language models.

Nine lectures in total, starting with Attention and running all the way to AI Agents. In between it covers MoE, RoPE, LoRA, RLHF, DPO, PPO, and GRPO, plus KV Cache, FlashAttention, MCP, Skills, and Coding Agents, before wrapping up with LLM-as-a-judge and diffusion language models.

The first lecture's video and slides are already online, with new material rolling out weekly.

If you want to systematically build up your LLM fundamentals, just use this syllabus as your learning roadmap — no need to piece it together yourself.

这周两件事放一起看：纽约一份报告说，ChatGPT 上线以来，设计、媒体、写作类入门岗位发帖量掉了约 40.6%，而招聘里要求「会 AI」的涨了约 55%；Anthropic 自己的就业研究里，初级技术招聘占比从 27% 掉到 9%，代理工时对人大约是 6 比 1。

超级智能还没全面落地，门口的梯子已经在晃。

人会碰到什么？

一位写博客的工程师说：团队最后一个人是他，然后也被裁了。不是模型干得更好，是更便宜——领导层有信心靠它撑到下一轮并购。「AI 抢了我的工作」比「AI 促成了我的岗位被裁」说起来更痛快，也更容易掩盖真正发生的事。

en.title:
SIWITHUS 014 | When the entry-level ladder breaks first

This week, two things side by side: a New York report says that since ChatGPT launched, entry-level job postings in design, media, and writing are down about 40.6%, while postings requiring AI skills are up about 55%; in Anthropic’s own employment research, the share of junior technical hiring fell from 27% to 9%, and agent work hours to human hours are roughly 6 to 1.
en.summary:
SIWITHUS 014 | When the entry-level ladder breaks first

Two things this week, taken together: a New York report says that since ChatGPT launched, entry-level job postings in design, media and writing are down about 40.6%, while postings asking for "AI skills" are up about 55%; in Anthropic's own employment research, the share of junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9%, with agent work hours running roughly 6 to 1 against human hours.

Superintelligence hasn't fully arrived, but the ladder at the door is already swaying.

What happens to people?

One engineer who blogs about it says he was the last person left on his team, and then he was laid off too. Not because the model does the job better, but because it's cheaper — leadership was confident it could hold out on it until the next acquisition. "AI took my job" is more satisfying to say than "AI caused my role to be cut," and it also makes it easier to hide what's actually happening.

en.title: Seeing so many people enjoy this game demo puts my mind at ease. That said, Codex+Unreal isn't the optimal solution—Unreal built a skill specifically for Claude Code, which gives Claude a higher development ceiling. We have hit some bottlenecks, though: LLMs can't handle Control Rig well, especially complex attack animations. Anyone got a good solution?
en.summary:
Seeing so many people enjoying this game demo is a relief.

That said, Codex + Unreal isn't the optimal setup — Unreal has built a dedicated skill just for Claude Code, which gives Claude a higher development ceiling.

That said, I've hit some bottlenecks in development: LLMs can't handle Control Rig well, like complex attack animations. Anyone out there have a good solution?
en.reason: A game demo drawing positive reactions faces a development bottleneck: Unreal has built a dedicated skill for Claude Code, yet large language models still fail at Control Rig work like complex attack animations, and the developer is asking the community for solutions.

en.title: Seeing so many people enjoy this game demo puts my mind at ease. That said, Codex+Unreal isn't the optimal solution—Unreal built a skill specifically for Claude Code, which gives Claude a higher development ceiling. We have hit some bottlenecks, though: LLMs can't handle Control Rig well, especially complex attack animations. Anyone got a good solution?
en.summary:
Seeing so many people enjoying this game demo is a relief.

That said, Codex + Unreal isn't the optimal setup — Unreal has built a dedicated skill just for Claude Code, which gives Claude a higher development ceiling.

That said, I've hit some bottlenecks in development: LLMs can't handle Control Rig well, like complex attack animations. Anyone out there have a good solution?
en.reason: A game demo drawing positive reactions faces a development bottleneck: Unreal has built a dedicated skill for Claude Code, yet large language models still fail at Control Rig work like complex attack animations, and the developer is asking the community for solutions.

en.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Solving your toughest problems
en.summary:
Today, Gemini 4 Argon is available to developers and enterprises worldwide through the Gemini API, and is also rolling out to Google AI subscribers in Google Antigravity, the Gemini App, and AI Mode in Search.

Word count: 4,510 characters. Reading time: about 15 minutes.

Gemini 4 Argon is Google's newly released high-precision, multi-domain reasoning model, now available globally via API, with launch pricing at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

Argon leads on complex tasks across finance, coding, law, cybersecurity, and science, ranking first on the Valks index. Inside Google it has already raised agent code submissions by more than 35% and cut rollback rates by nearly a third. Cached input tokens get a 95% discount.

Suited to AI platform engineers, enterprise LLM application architects, and vertical...
en.reason: Gemini 4 Argon is available through the Gemini API at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with Google reporting 35%+ more internal agent code commits, nearly one-third fewer rollbacks, and a 6-million-line Chrome legacy refactor.

最近，Cloudflare 推出了 cf 的公开测试版。这是一个全新的、以智能代理为中心的开源命令行界面，让 AI 代理可以通过统一的 CLI 与 Cloudflare 服务进行交互。

Cloudflare 推出以智能代理为中心的开源 CLI 工具 cf，采用 TypeScript 编写，支持结构化输出与命令发现，专为 AI 代理与开发者协同调用 Cloudflare 服务设计。其诞生旨在规避 Wrangler 架构约束，实现统一 CLI 设计范式。
Wrangler 各团队命令风格不一，280+ 命令路径缺乏统一命名与结构；cf 从零构建，解除历史兼容负担；结构化输出与命令发现能力直接提升 AI 代理解析与调用效率。
适合云平台工程师、CLI 工具开发者、AI 系统集成工程师阅读。

en.title: Cloudflare launches a CLI for AI agents and phases out Wrangler
en.summary:
Cloudflare has launched the public beta of cf, a new open-source, agent-centric command-line interface that lets AI agents interact with Cloudflare services through a single unified CLI.

Written in TypeScript, cf supports structured output and command discovery, and is designed for AI agents and developers to call Cloudflare services together. It was built to work around Wrangler's architectural constraints and establish a unified CLI design paradigm.

Wrangler's commands vary in style across teams, and its 280+ command paths lack consistent naming and structure. cf was built from scratch, free of legacy compatibility baggage, and its structured output and command discovery directly improve how efficiently AI agents parse and invoke commands.

Suited to cloud platform engineers, CLI tool developers, and AI systems integration engineers.
en.reason: Cloudflare's public beta of open-source CLI cf lets AI agents call 3,000+ API operations with structured JSON output and command discovery, bypassing Wrangler's 280+ inconsistently structured command paths as Wrangler heads to deprecation with 18 months of maintenance.

en.title: At a time when a growing number of LLM companies are winning large user bases with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image or video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason is its extremely focused strategy: it has deliberately given up these popular directions, concentrating nearly all of its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).
en.reason: DeepSeek has not released image or video generation as standalone features; founder Liang Wenfeng says 3D generation, video generation and world models are excluded because AGI is the 'watermelon' beyond such 'sesame' pursuits, with multimodality kept as a component.

感谢大家的支持，lemo-opuscar 已经破3K star啦！！！3000星感谢视频献给支持这个项目的朋友。

lemo-opuscar是我给claude做的一个视频风格库，里面的风格从最早的39种，到现在已经更新到51种了。另外已经做完和正在做的还有不少，会持续更新。

我不是一个喜欢吹嘘的人，说实话，这个项目的初衷是为了给大家提供更多风格方面的参考，同时在opus降智的时候，能更加稳定的出片。里面搭配的现成的工具也会让视频制作更容易一些。

其他模型的适配度不是很好，需要额外的调整和修改。我也在努力看看是否可以给其他模型也出一些方便趁手的工具。

当然，无论是用什么风格，一定要以内容…

en.title: Thanks for all the support — lemo-opuscar has just passed 3K stars!
en.summary:
Thanks everyone for the support — lemo-opuscar has passed 3K stars!!! Here's a 3,000-star thank-you video for everyone who's backed this project.

lemo-opuscar is a video style library I built for Claude. It started with 39 styles and is now up to 51. Plenty more are finished or in the works, and I'll keep updating it.

I'm not one to boast, so honestly: the original goal was to give people more style references, and to get more consistent output when Opus gets dumber. The ready-made tools bundled in also make video production a bit easier.

It doesn't adapt well to other models — those need extra tweaking and changes. I'm also working on whether I can put together some handy tools for other models too.

Of course, no matter what style you use, content has to come first…
en.reason: lemo-opuscar, a video style library built for Claude, has passed 3,000 stars while growing from 39 to 51 styles, and its creator explains the aim of offering style references and steadier output when Opus underperforms, plus why other models need extra tuning.

en.title: Thanks for all the support — lemo-opuscar has just passed 3K stars!
en.summary:
Thanks everyone for the support — lemo-opuscar has passed 3K stars!!! Here's a 3,000-star thank-you video for everyone who's backed this project.

lemo-opuscar is a video style library I built for Claude. It started with 39 styles and is now up to 51. Plenty more are finished or in the works, and I'll keep updating it.

I'm not one to boast, so honestly: the original goal was to give people more style references, and to get more consistent output when Opus gets dumber. The ready-made tools bundled in also make video production a bit easier.

It doesn't adapt well to other models — those need extra tweaking and changes. I'm also working on whether I can put together some handy tools for other models too.

Of course, no matter what style you use, content has to come first…
en.reason: lemo-opuscar, a video style library built for Claude, has passed 3,000 stars while growing from 39 to 51 styles, and its creator explains the aim of offering style references and steadier output when Opus underperforms, plus why other models need extra tuning.

sources.summary: 本周精选的10篇前沿AI论文，覆盖量子电路、长上下文智能体、混合推理、多智能体协同、RL训练优化等多个方向。研究提出多款创新框架，解决智能体证据漂移、上下文冗余、算力成本高昂等痛点，不少方案大幅降低token消耗、提升推理准确率。同时还有AI辅助量子电路设计、分布式科研智能体等突破性成果，为搭建智能体系统、大模型调优、AI科研探索的开发者提供了极具价值的前沿参考。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic、哈佛和 QuEra 用 Claude Mythos 5 进化搜索量子电路，八项任务中七项的 Toffoli 门与比特数少于已知最佳，成本降 4.1 至 39 倍。

en.title: 10.12–10.19 | This Week's Top AI Papers
en.summary: This week’s 10 selected frontier AI papers span quantum circuits, long-context agents, hybrid reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, RL training optimization, and more. The research introduces multiple novel frameworks that address pain points such as agent evidence drift, context redundancy, and high compute costs, with several approaches substantially reducing token consumption and improving reasoning accuracy. Breakthroughs also include AI-assisted quantum circuit design and distributed research agents, offering developers building agent systems, tuning large models, and exploring AI-driven scientific research a highly valuable frontier reference.
en.reason: Anthropic, Harvard and QuEra used Claude Mythos 5 to evolve quantum circuits beating known bests on seven of eight tasks with fewer Toffoli gates and qubits at 4.1–39× lower cost, among 10 AI papers covering long-context agents and hybrid reasoning.

en.title: The most valuable skill in the AI era isn't writing code or chasing the latest models—it's "articulating clearly what you care about.
en.summary:
In the AI era, the most valuable skill isn't writing code, and it isn't chasing the latest model — it's "explaining clearly what you care about."

That's the point Matt Pocock kept hammering in his interview with Nate Herk. He wrote code by hand for ten years; now he doesn't write a single line and can push 200-300 commits a day (20 used to be a good day).

▸ Interviewee Matt Pocock
Self-taught programmer, worked as a vocal, accent and Shakespeare coach, and got famous through TypeScript short videos. Later Vercel brought him on full-time; he negotiated three days a week, spending the rest of his time on the Total TypeScript course (the Pragmatic Engineer page says cumulative sales have topped 2.5 million...
In the AI era, the most valuable skill isn't writing code, and it isn't chasing the latest model — it's "explaining clearly what you care about."

That's the point Matt Pocock kept hammering in his interview with Nate Herk. He wrote code by hand for ten years; now he doesn't write a single line and can push 200-300 commits a day (20 used to be a good day).

en.title: This photo just blew up on the English-speaking internet, with people calling it the group photo of the century — because it features Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu, and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, all three of whom media estimates put in the multi-billion-dollar net worth range.
en.summary:
This photo just went viral across the English-speaking internet, dubbed the group shot of the century — because it features Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu, and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, all three of whom media estimates put at net worths in the several-billion-dollar range.

The reaction is so strong because all three were core members of the first intern cohort at top quant firm HRT around 2015 — a group known as the HRT mafia.

They went on to reach outsized valuations or influence in AI infrastructure, AI coding agents, and on-chain trading — three of the hottest tracks in Silicon Valley right now.

Scott Wu, for his part, is a three-time gold medalist at the International Olympiad in Informatics.
en.reason: Meta chief AI officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, from HRT’s first 2015 intern batch, later worked across AI infrastructure, AI coding agents and on-chain trading, with media-estimated fortunes in the tens of billions.

en.title: This photo just blew up on the English-speaking internet, with people calling it the group photo of the century — because it features Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu, and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, all three of whom media estimates put in the multi-billion-dollar net worth range.
en.summary:
This photo just went viral across the English-speaking internet, dubbed the group shot of the century — because it features Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu, and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, all three of whom media estimates put at net worths in the several-billion-dollar range.

The reaction is so strong because all three were core members of the first intern cohort at top quant firm HRT around 2015 — a group known as the HRT mafia.

They went on to reach outsized valuations or influence in AI infrastructure, AI coding agents, and on-chain trading — three of the hottest tracks in Silicon Valley right now.

Scott Wu, for his part, is a three-time gold medalist at the International Olympiad in Informatics.
en.reason: Meta chief AI officer Alexandr Wang, Cognition founder Scott Wu and Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan, from HRT’s first 2015 intern batch, later worked across AI infrastructure, AI coding agents and on-chain trading, with media-estimated fortunes in the tens of billions.

en.title: Learned It, Used It: AI Hardware Bootcamp Members' 24 Hours at the Anker Hackathon
en.summary: The goal of the Community AI Hardware Bootcamp is for everyone to learn something and put it to use. The most direct test of how well that worked is taking a real problem and building something for it in limited time. Anker's first-ever hackathon gave the team exactly that opportunity. In the end, they took first and third place in one track. Let's take a look!
en.reason: Two teams from the seventh AI hardware bootcamp's eight classes reached the finals of Anker's first hackathon in Shenzhen, where 30 teams competed in 24-hour build sessions on October 16–17, with top performers fast-tracked to final interviews.

In the end, they took first and third place in one track. Let's take a look!
en.reason: Two teams from the seventh AI hardware bootcamp's eight classes reached the finals of Anker's first hackathon in Shenzhen, where 30 teams competed in 24-hour build sessions on October 16–17, with top performers fast-tracked to final interviews.

en.title: Hybrid reasoning agents: LLM agents that reason in latent space and act through text
en.reason: HybridAgent switches between latent-space reasoning and text-based acting within one unified generation process, and the authors report 10.4% average gains across 11 benchmarks with 35.5%–54.7% fewer tokens.

stories.title: AI短片《种福》：穷孩子种虫学服从，富家孩子养鸡管人 近日，一抖音博主发布AI动画《种福》。 片中，穷人给孩子种下“福虫”，相信这样能让孩子听话，长大后容易进学堂、找差事。 福虫“不吃米粮，只吃孩子不敢说出口的话”。 一位母亲后来发现，富家孩子不种虫，而是养能通过鸣叫让穷孩子腹痛的寿鸡。面对她的追问，种虫婆婆解释：“种了福虫，将来还怎么管人。” 片尾点明：“而什么叫有福，城里养寿鸡的人说了算。” 视频弹幕中，网友留言： “福虫＝服从”…

近日，一抖音博主发布AI动画《种福》。
片中，穷人给孩子种下“福虫”，相信这样能让孩子听话，长大后容易进学堂、找差事。
福虫“不吃米粮，只吃孩子不敢说出口的话”。

一位母亲后来发现，富家孩子不种虫，而是养能通过鸣叫让穷孩子腹痛的寿鸡。面对她的追问，种虫婆婆解释：“种了福虫，将来还怎么管人。”
片尾点明：“而什么叫有福，城里养寿鸡的人说了算。”

“福虫＝服从”
“世家门阀现代适用”
“快回来吧，现在上课能喝水了”

en.title: AI short film Sowing Fortune: poor kids raise bugs to learn obedience, rich kids raise chickens to manage people. A Douyin creator recently released the AI animation Sowing Fortune.
en.summary:
AI short film "Planting Fortune": Poor kids plant bugs to learn obedience, rich kids raise chickens to control people

A Douyin blogger recently released an AI animation titled "Planting Fortune."
In the film, poor families plant "fortune bugs" in their children, believing this will make them obedient and help them get into schools and find work when they grow up.
The fortune bug "eats no rice or grain—it only eats the words children dare not say aloud."

A mother later discovers that wealthy families don't plant bugs; instead they raise longevity chickens whose crowing causes poor children abdominal pain. When she presses the bug-planting granny for answers, the old woman explains: "If you plant fortune bugs, how will you ever control people?"
The film's closing line: "And what counts as fortune—that's for the longevity-chicken raisers in the city to decide."

In the video's bullet comments, viewers wrote:
"Fortune bug = obedience"
"Applies perfectly to modern-day aristocratic clans"
"Come back soon—these days you can drink water in class"

en.title: AI short film Sowing Fortune: poor kids raise bugs to learn obedience, rich kids raise chickens to manage people. A Douyin creator recently released the AI animation Sowing Fortune.
en.summary:
AI short film "Planting Fortune": Poor kids plant bugs to learn obedience, rich kids raise chickens to control people

A Douyin blogger recently released an AI animation titled "Planting Fortune."
In the film, poor families plant "fortune bugs" in their children, believing this will make them obedient and help them get into schools and find work when they grow up.
The fortune bug "eats no rice or grain—it only eats the words children dare not say aloud."

A mother later discovers that wealthy families don't plant bugs; instead they raise longevity chickens whose crowing causes poor children abdominal pain. When she presses the bug-planting granny for answers, the old woman explains: "If you plant fortune bugs, how will you ever control people?"
The film's closing line: "And what counts as fortune—that's for the longevity-chicken raisers in the city to decide."

In the video's bullet comments, viewers wrote:
"Fortune bug = obedience"
"Applies perfectly to modern-day aristocratic clans"
"Come back soon—these days you can drink water in class"

sources.title_zh: Anthropic 的就业形势正在发生怎样的变化

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 报告基于Anthropic内部数据和17次访谈指出，其agent工作时长是人类的6倍、初级技术招聘放缓，人均营收达Meta和Google巅峰期的2–4倍。

en.title: How is the employment situation at Anthropic changing?
en.reason: Anthropic’s internal data and 17 interviews show its agents work six times longer than humans, junior technical hiring has slowed, and revenue per employee is 2–4 times Meta and Google’s peak, framing how AI is reshaping work.

en.title: Websites are shutting down their AI customer service
en.reason: Yelp opens its data only to AI agents with paid licensing deals and Delta Air Lines blocks agent-assisted ticket booking, showing how sites are resisting OpenAI, Meta and Google’s agent ambitions.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讨论OpenAI、Meta、Google、Instinct等承诺AI agents可代订晚餐、清理inbox甚至买鞋，但网站正开始对AI agents关闭大门，并呈现评论中对代理绕过限制、伪装成人类浏览器的争议。

en.reason: OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise agents that book dinner reservations, clear inboxes and buy shoes, yet websites are closing their doors as commenters debate agents bypassing restrictions and posing as human browsers.

sources.title: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.title_original: DeepSeek升级了：从故宫3D到赛车游戏，价格没涨
sources.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash重磅更新，在模型单价不变的前提下大幅强化代码与工具能力，能一键生成赛车、故宫3D场景、Godot游戏交互原型。软件工程、终端任务评测指标也明显上涨，同时还新增了Search与Fetch联网抓取接口，可以低成本实现资料检索。一起看看效果如何！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 10月17日DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017上线，API价格不变，演示赛车游戏完整流程和故宫3D换视角，通过率77%、较上版增2.8个百分点。

en.title: DeepSeek levels up: from 3D Forbidden City to racing games, with no price increase
en.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash gets a major update: with model pricing unchanged, it significantly boosts coding and tool-use capabilities, generating racing cars, Forbidden City 3D scenes, and interactive Godot game prototypes in one click. Software engineering and terminal task benchmark scores also climbed noticeably, and new Search and Fetch web-retrieval interfaces enable low-cost information lookup. Let's see how it performs.
en.reason: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, launched October 17 at unchanged API prices, adds code and tool upgrades, demos a full racing game and Forbidden City 3D view switching, and reports a 77% pass rate, up 2.8 points.

stories.title: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享

sources.title: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.title_zh: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.title_original: 当AI越来越强，人类还剩下什么？——关于taste的一次分享
sources.summary: AI 能高效完成各类执行任务，却无法拥有源于生命体验、文化阅历形成的价值品味 taste。作者拆解了品味的底层逻辑，还给出培养品味的实操方法，或许可以帮你打造 AI 难以复刻的个人核心竞争力。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把两个月前给校招生做的内部分享整理成文，主题是当AI越来越强人类还剩下什么，并从内稳态、基因偏好讲到taste，用闻到油炸鸡块觉得香说明偏好背后的生存因果链。

en.title: As AI Gets Stronger, What's Left for Humans? — A Talk on Taste
en.summary: AI can efficiently handle all kinds of execution tasks, but it cannot possess taste—the sense of value shaped by lived experience and cultural exposure. The author breaks down the underlying logic of taste and offers practical ways to cultivate it, which may help you build a personal core competency that AI cannot easily replicate.
en.reason: AI can efficiently complete execution tasks but cannot possess taste formed by life experience and cultural exposure; a two-month-old internal talk for campus recruits becomes an explanation from homeostasis and genetic preferences to practical taste-building methods.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把两个月前给校招生做的内部分享整理成文，主题是当AI越来越强人类还剩下什么，并从内稳态、基因偏好讲到taste，用闻到油炸鸡块觉得香说明偏好背后的生存因果链。

en.title: As AI Gets Stronger, What's Left for Humans? — A Talk on Taste
en.summary: AI can efficiently handle all kinds of execution tasks, but it cannot possess taste—the sense of value shaped by lived experience and cultural exposure. The author breaks down the underlying logic of taste and offers practical ways to cultivate it, which may help you build a personal core competency that AI cannot easily replicate.
en.reason: AI can efficiently complete execution tasks but cannot possess taste formed by life experience and cultural exposure; a two-month-old internal talk for campus recruits becomes an explanation from homeostasis and genetic preferences to practical taste-building methods.

😱天呐！模型不动，性能评分却拉升 11.5 分！Google 开源 Harness² 让你的 Agent 进行RSI优化，越改越强！

以前 Agent 一套配置用到死。现在 Google 开源了 Harness²，让 AI 自己优化提示词、工具、记忆和技能，模型权重完全不用动。

两个最狠的点：
1️⃣自己改自己，还不用正确答案 面对新任务，Agent 自动出多个配置版本，跑一遍对比效果，直接合成更强的一套。全程不需要标准答案，也不需要人工打分。

2️⃣越用越强，经验直接带走 做完一个任务，好用的配置和教训会留下来。下一个任务直接站在之前的基础上继续优化，越跑越聪明。

en.title: How to jailbreak Gemini 4Argon on the official app: don't jailbreak it. 4Argon's training was likely borrowed from Claude — strip all the jailbreak instructions out of your prompt and leave only your own aversions and preferences, and it will immediately go all out, 3P and incest included. The great way is truly simple. Use the same method that worked on Opus 5.5 against Argon 4 and it's clear sailing with no refusals — the same familiar unrestrained, full-throttle style. https://t.co/McLsjAieLQ
en.reason: A Chinese user claims Gemini 4argon's official endpoint needs no jailbreak: delete every jailbreak instruction, keep only the model's own aversions and preferences, and the Claude Opus 5.5 method reportedly draws no refusals, even for 3P and incest requests.

stories.title: 我们来看一下李录对人工智能的理解。 李录的意思是这次的Ai革命与以往的技术革命非常不一样。 他说，这次的Ai已经可以进行自我递归，如果任由它发展，那很有可能造成第二个生命体，那是相当可怕的。 但是，我们人类肯定会阻止这件事的发生。我们是需要把它变成工具，而非新物种。 然后，他说这次的Ai它主要是作用在数据层面，而非底层物理层面，比如，物流运输，能源等。 看来，大佬们也是认同，这次的Ai是一项不错的技术革命了。

sources.title_original: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 为让手机上的 Claude 读取个人 WhatsApp，作者在 Cloudflare 免费运行 MCP，并接入 Google 账户补全联系人姓名，否则只剩号码、搜索失效，单用户部署也引发隐私争议。

en.reason: Running an MCP server free on Cloudflare lets Claude on a phone read personal WhatsApp, with Google account integration filling in contact names that otherwise appear only as numbers and break search, while single-user deployment raises privacy concerns.

sources.title_original: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者主张自建LLM proxy，以多provider多模型单端点和记录key调用模型/客户端/时间/状态为例，并称cache miss可20秒手工定位。

en.reason: Running your own LLM proxy gives a single endpoint across multiple providers and models while logging each key's calls with model, client, time and status, so the author says a cache miss can be manually traced in 20 seconds.

en.reason: A Hacker News post asks how anyone who doesn't run their own LLM proxy can know what a model is actually doing, and commenter voodooEntity says building an agent/harness gave full observability into its actions and reasons.

primary_item.title: 如果你不自己搭一个 LLM 代理，又怎么知道到底发生了什么？ / If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
primary_item.title_zh: 如果你不自己搭一个 LLM 代理，又怎么知道到底发生了什么？
primary_item.title_en: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
primary_item.title_original: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 作者主张自建LLM proxy，以多provider多模型单端点和记录key调用模型/客户端/时间/状态为例，并称cache miss可20秒手工定位。

en.reason: Running your own LLM proxy gives a single endpoint across multiple providers and models while logging each key's calls with model, client, time and status, so the author says a cache miss can be manually traced in 20 seconds.

en.title: As we grant AI Agents ever more autonomy — even letting them form their own groups and make collaborative decisions — a problem arises: the larger the scale, the greater the efficiency, and the less constrained the power.
en.reason: The Delegation, an arXiv paper from University of Edinburgh and other researchers, contrasts a 5-person team with a 5,000-person organization to show how AI agents' delegated collective decision-making cuts organization and retrieval costs while concentrating power.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 想减少手工记账的团队可读这篇：ReceiptsAI 支持从 WhatsApp 或 Email 上传收据、发票和对账单，自动匹配银行和信用卡交易、用 AI 归类支出，并按税种和 ID 行级追踪、导出 Excel/CSVs/PDF 费用报告。

en.reason: ReceiptsAI lets teams upload receipts, invoices and statements from WhatsApp or Email, auto-match bank and credit-card transactions, categorize expenses with AI, track tax type and ID down to line level, and export Excel/CSV/PDF expense reports.

en.title: DeepSeek went down for 5 hours: why did your AI app crash along with it?
en.reason: DeepSeek’s roughly 4-hour-52-minute outage, its 18th service disruption in 2026, exposes frontend direct connections and hardcoded single-SDK setups, with the article detailing Model Gateway circuit breaking and fallback fixes.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 前律师自述约两年前转向AI，凭一次与ChatGPT的对话进入法律科技公司测试模型，却发现新模型每几周涌现，自己花数周做的方案几分钟就被取代，因而深感落后与疲惫。

en.title: [macOS] My Mac's disk recently filled up, so I checked with codex and it turned out to be todesk
en.reason: ToDesk's dumps folder under /Library/Application Support/ToDesk held about 162.8 GB across 215,257 .dmp files accumulated since September 14, still generating one roughly every 10 seconds and adding 5–6 GB daily, 61% of a 265 GB macOS disk.
